author: The Engineering Mindset
description:
Learn how voltage regulators actually work and how to design and build one.
Check out PCBWAY➡️ https://www.pcbway.com/ for PCB's, 3D printing and CNC at expectational value and design PCB's with Altium ➡️ http://altium.com/yt/engineeringmindset
Learn how an LM317 adjustable voltage regulator turns unregulated DC into a smooth, stable output for electronics projects. In this video, we build a DIY adjustable power supply, explain how resistors and a potentiometer set the output voltage, explore dropout voltage, heat dissipation, protection diodes, filter capacitors, and even look inside the regulator using a laser teardown to understand how it really works. Perfect for beginners learning electronics, PCB design, and power supply circuits.
